title: implement unbroadcast

atoms.evidence: Solution implements the canonical 2-step inverse: (1) n_dims_to_sum = len(broadcasted.shape) - len(original.shape); broadcasted.sum(axis=tuple(range(n_dims_to_sum))) — sum prepended dims; (2) sum over size-1 dims with keepdims=True

Markdown explicitly frames: 'the unbroadcasting process is the same process in reverse: 1. Sum over prepended dimensions... 2. Sum over dimensions where original had size 1' — broadcasting ↔ summing duality stated directly

Exercise prose explicitly walks through broadcast rules: 'broadcasting original to the shape of broadcasted can be described as a 2-step process: 1. Extend dummy dimensions (size 1)... 2. Prepend dimensions' — the right-align/size-1-stretch rules being inverted

notes: 3 atoms — matches seed prediction of 4 (1 atom less). Fundamental building block that every binary backward (multiply, max, add/sub/div) depends on. The 2-step inverse-broadcast pattern is taught in one self-contained exercise.
